newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOL $200 mln unsecured bonds due June 9.
newsitem.headline: UOL $200 mln unsecured bonds due June 9.

text.p: United Overseas Land Ltd (UOL) said on Friday redemption of its Singapore $200 million unsecured bonds would be due on June 9, 1997.

UOL, the property arm of United Overseas Bank group said in a statement its company's bonds are to be redeemed in whole on June 9 at their principal amounts together with the accrued interest due for payment on the same day.
"Payment of the principal amount and interest will be made on June 9, 1997," UOL said in a statement.
The bonds would be removed from the official list of the Stock Exchange of Singapore Limited on June 10 and the last day for trading of the bonds would be May 27, 1997, UOL said.
